alex.s: Hey team — PR #2567 is ready to land (small routing fix). CI is hung on one job (integration/arm-macos). We need to land before the upcoming deploy freeze at 2024-03-16 06:00 UTC. Who can +1 for a manual canary if CI green? @maria @ben :eyes:

maria: I can watch CI. If that job stays flaky we can do a manual canary + manual merge, but I'd prefer to avoid forcing a merge unless @sre-oncall is okay with the rollback plan.

ci-bot: build started for PR 2567 — job id 7890 (integration/arm-macos)

alex.s: Job 7890 has been stuck ~12m on the same test. I can re-run the job but trying to avoid thrashing the CI queue. Could we target just the failing job? e.g. `/ci retry 7890 --job integration/arm-macos`

ben: I can do the quick smoke on staging once it goes green. Ping me when it's done or if you need me to kick something. @alex.s

maria: If we need a formal rebase slot, I have a quiet window tomorrow 04:30–05:15 UTC and can rebase + smoke then, as long as there's no DB migration landing in that window. Ops flagged a blackout 06:00–09:00 UTC so we must finish before 06:00.

sre-oncall: :eyes: I'll standby at 04:25 UTC. If you want a manual canary, tag the release `canary/manual/pr-2567` and I'll promote if health looks good. I also want the rollback playbook link in the PR description.

alex.s: Kicked a targeted retry. Failing log snippet below: 
```
FAILED TEST integration/arm-macos/test_route_shard.py::TestShardRouting::test_shard_overflow
AssertionError: expected status 200, got 503
Traceback (most recent call last):
  File "tests/test_route_shard.py", line 48, in test_shard_overflow
    resp = client.post('/route', json=payload)
  File "/usr/local/lib/python3.10/site-packages/requests/sessions.py", line 555, in post
    return self.request('POST', url, json=json, **kwargs)
```

ci-bot: job 7890 restarted; integration/arm-macos queued on runner sm-03; ETA ~8m

ben: If the dedicated mac runner keeps failing we should reroute to `runner=mac-dedicated-2` — that runner has more RAM for the test fixture.

alex.s: Plan: 1) let this retry run. 2) If green, do manual canary at ~05:00 UTC and request @ben smoke. 3) If still flaky, request rebase slot at 04:45 UTC and we do a manual merge with +1s from @ben and @maria and explicit ok from @sre-oncall. I will update this thread with CI status.

maria: sgtm :thumbsup:

alex.s: Update: job passed at 1712351200. @ben can you run the staging smoke at 05:00 UTC? If smoke +1 I'll merge and tag canary/manual/pr-2567. Thanks everyone.
